verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs include a dedicated 'Webhooks' page, and event filters built on CEL expressions suggest event-driven triggering. However, the pack contains only that page title, with no description of whether users can subscribe to platform events, how they would configure webhook endpoints, or what payloads and delivery guarantees apply. Missing for 10: any documented content describing webhook event subscription (direction, configuration, event types, retries/signing), independent or hands-on corroboration.
